content.value:
For given path loss exponent (i) n=4 and (ii) n=3, find the frequency reuse factor and the“ (12)   
cluster size that should be used for maximum capacity. The signal to interference ratio of 15   
dB is minimum required for satisfactory forward channel performance of a cellular system.   
There are 6 co-channel cells in the first tier and all of them are at the same distance from the   
mobile. Use suitable approximations.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
